summary: Measure slow chat and provider paths without changing their behavior. Main and renderer share monotonic timing thresholds; chat history responses add optional diagnostic timing fields, and a local script summarizes persisted spans.

reactNativeIos.reason: No phone UI or chat-open instrumentation is added. The existing phone API tolerates optional chat history timing fields; its backend calls receive the same server-side measurements.

nativeAndroid.reason: No Android UI or native code changes. Optional history response fields are ignored by existing clients; backend request timing also covers phone requests.

storageDataMigration.reason: Timing is diagnostic metadata in existing rotating log files and optional response fields. No persisted conversation setting, database schema, migration or transcript content changes.

updateRelease.reason: No package identity, native dependency, signing, deep link, OTA runtime, release channel or packaging changes. Optional timing metadata is backward compatible with existing desktop and phone clients.

automated: Vitest fake-clock threshold and span tests, summary parser/percentile tests, slow IPC behavior tests, and chat commit/frame lifecycle tests.
Root typecheck and full vitest gate.
notExercised: No real provider accounts, phone hardware, production timing session or network deployment exercised.
React commit duration logging skipped: production Profiler is unavailable and component-function timers do not measure full React commits.
No visual baselines changed: no markup, styling or visible behavior changes.
